gui_spec_scope_rationale: Phase 1 default-on rule classifies this as GUI (a user-visible copy addition in a React app), so it is NOT exempted from the process. But Phase 2-4 are scoped down: the change adds ONE static hint line near the existing Host Drawer CTA (frontend/src/components/drawer.tsx HostSection, ~line 1085-1096) with no new component, no new API call, no loading/error/async state, and no user interaction beyond what the Host button already does. There is exactly one UI state (rendered) — no state diagram transitions exist to draw. Per gui-spec.md this still requires an E2E test tracing to the AC and data-testid on the new element; it does NOT warrant a mock test (no empty/loading/error/edge state exists to mock — matches the S1f75ec-1 precedent of `"mock": null` for a similarly state-less Story). Logged as an autonomous decision in decisions.json.

steps.action: open the app (Drawer visible) — do not open any repository
steps.expected: Host section is visible (data-testid=drawer-host-section) with the existing Host button (data-testid=drawer-host-terminal)

steps.action: look at the text under/near the Host button
steps.expected: a hint line is visible (data-testid=drawer-host-gh-hint) mentioning gh and that it is installable via 設定 → デプロイ設定 → アプリ (the App Catalog, internal/apps/catalog.go id="gh", surfaced in frontend/src/components/apps-section.tsx)
